source.label: Kineticist Eight Ball rules and strategy

strategy.summary: Build 5x Bonus at the candy cane before taking repeated lit-spinner shots, complete your numbered rack while another ball remains, then hit the lit 8-ball pad to start persistent Super Bonus on later balls.

steps.text: On ball one, plunge for the 4 lane in your numbered set.
modeNotes: Rack: Each player owns seven numbered balls plus the neutral 8-ball. Players one and three collect 1 through 7. Players two and four collect 9 through 15.
The first four numbered balls are top lanes. The next two are standup targets. The final numbered ball is the right return lane.
Each collected numbered ball adds 3,000 to base bonus. Rack progress stays through the game.

steps.text: If the kickback and spinner are not lit, hit the 8-ball pad once.
modeNotes: Kickback: A one-use left-outlane save. An 8-ball-pad hit lights it before rack completion. A successful save turns off both the kickback and the lit spinner.
Lit Spinner: The left spinner scores 1,000 per spin after an 8-ball-pad hit. Hit the pad again to relight it after a kickback save.

steps.text: Shoot the candy cane from the left flipper. Hit its star rollover five times to reach 5x Bonus.
modeNotes: Candy Cane: The upper-right horseshoe lane and star rollover. Star hits one and two raise the shot value. Hits three, four, and five give 2x, 3x, and 5x Bonus.
Extra Ball: The step after 5x is the Extra Ball step. Confirm whether the installed game requires a separate collect shot. Later steps score 5,000.
All four top lanes light one of the two center top-lane arrows. Switch hits move the arrow. Rolling through the lit center lane advances the same candy-cane ladder.
Bonus X: The 2x, 3x, or 5x value multiplies normal end-of-ball bonus for the current ball.

steps.text: After 5x is active, shoot the lit spinner from a controlled right-flipper hold.
Collect your first six numbered balls. Let the right return lane collect the seventh during normal play.
modeNotes: Rack completion: Complete 1 through 7 or 9 through 15. The 8-ball pad then lights for the rack finish.
Do not force the final standup or return lane when its feed is not controlled. Progress stays for a later ball.

steps.text: After all seven numbered balls are collected, hit the lit 8-ball pad.
modeNotes: Super Bonus: Completing the rack and the lit 8-ball pad qualifies a 24,000 base for the player's next and every later turn. At each drain, add 3,000 for every ball lit in the current rack, then apply Bonus X.
Rack reset: The completed rack clears at the start of the player's next turn. New rack balls then add to the persistent 24,000 Super Bonus base.
Special: Rack completion lights the right outlane. A roll through it collects the configured replay, Extra Ball, or points award.

fallback.title: Candy cane and controlled bonus
fallback.when: Use this plan when rack targets or the 8-ball pad reject dangerously.

steps.text: Plunge for a missing top lane. Use switch hits to move the lit 2 or 3 lane.
Shoot the candy cane until 5x Bonus is active.
Hit the 8-ball pad once to light the spinner and kickback.
Shoot the lit spinner only from a controlled flipper hold.
Let normal feeds collect rack numbers. Do not force 5, 6, or 7.
Protect the 5x end-of-ball bonus.

alternatives.title: Rack and Super Bonus
alternatives.when: Use this route when another player ball remains and only safe rack numbers are missing.

steps.text: Collect the four top-lane numbers for your player set.
Collect the two matching standup targets only from controlled shots.
Let the right return lane collect the seventh number.
Hit the lit 8-ball pad to complete the rack.
On the next ball, raise Bonus X and collect balls in the new rack before the drain. Super Bonus is 24,000 plus 3,000 per lit rack ball, all multiplied.

alternatives.title: Spinner after 5x
alternatives.when: Use this route when the candy cane and spinner shots are repeatable but rack completion is too far away.

steps.text: Shoot the candy cane until its star rollover has advanced Bonus X to 5x.
Hit the 8-ball pad to light the spinner.
Shoot the lit spinner from a controlled right-flipper hold.
Use the spinner return to collect top lanes and return to the candy cane.
If the kickback fires, hit the 8-ball pad again before another spinner attempt.
Reach 5x on the candy-cane ladder.
Complete the seven numbered balls in your rack.
Hit the lit 8-ball pad to qualify persistent Super Bonus.
On every later ball, add safe rack balls and rebuild Bonus X before the drain.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Bally Eight Ball from 1977, not Eight Ball Deluxe or a licensed copy with different code.
Read whether the left-outlane kickback starts lit and relight it from the 8-ball pad before relying on the save.
Confirm the Bank Shot Extra Ball step and whether Extra Ball or Special awards a ball, replay, or points.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: Test a right-flipper backhand to the 8-ball pad. Continue only when the rebound is controlled.

techniques.name: Counterclockwise candy-cane loop
techniques.instruction: Shoot the candy cane from the left flipper. A bumper rebound can also send the ball into the 8-ball pad.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: From a full left-flipper hold, test the spinner backhand once. Stop if the shot is weak or the return is unsafe.

techniques.name: Left-outlane settle
techniques.instruction: Use a small nudge to settle a slow ball near the left outlane into the lit kickback lane.

cautions.issue: A weak spinner shot can return toward the center drain.
cautions.response: Shoot the spinner from a controlled hold. Stop after a weak return.

cautions.issue: A slow 8-ball-pad rebound can travel toward the center drain.
cautions.response: Test the pad once. Use the safer direction if one flipper gives a controlled return.

cautions.issue: Pop-bumper exits can feed an outlane.
cautions.response: Track the bumper exit and nudge before the ball reaches the outlane post.

cautions.issue: The 5 and 6 standups can give dangerous rebounds.
cautions.response: Take those targets only from a controlled shot. Let incidental hits complete them when possible.

cautions.issue: The 7 return lane is not a reliable skill shot.
cautions.response: Do not force it from the plunge. Collect it from normal return-lane flow.

quickInfo.name: Main route
quickInfo.summary: Build 5x Bonus at the candy cane before you take repeated lit-spinner shots.

quickInfo.name: Safer fallback
quickInfo.summary: Candy cane and controlled bonus: Use this plan when rack targets or the 8-ball pad reject dangerously.

strategy.simpleOverview: In Eight Ball, five candy-cane rollovers raise Bonus X to 5x, while collecting seven numbered balls lights the 8-ball pad for persistent Super Bonus. Reach 5x before repeating the lit spinner, complete the rack while another ball remains, then hit the lit 8-ball pad.
strategy.overview: In Eight Ball, five candy-cane rollovers raise Bonus X to 5x, while collecting seven numbered balls lights the 8-ball pad for persistent Super Bonus. Build 5x first, use the lit spinner from control, and finish the rack without forcing dangerous targets. Hit the lit 8-ball pad, then rebuild the multiplier on each later ball.
machineSetup: Confirm Bally Eight Ball from 1977, not Eight Ball Deluxe or a licensed copy with different code.
Read whether the left-outlane kickback starts lit and relight it from the 8-ball pad before relying on the save.
Confirm the Bank Shot Extra Ball step and whether Extra Ball or Special awards a ball, replay, or points.
